basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (NIPER), SAS Nagar (Mohali) will hold a walk-in interview on 10 December 2026 (Thursday) for one Technical Assistant post under the CoE-AVAB project. Registration is from 03:00 pm to 03:30 pm and the interview starts from 03:30 pm at G-108, G-Block, NIPER-SAS Nagar – 160062 (Punjab). The post is temporary, with fixed pay of Rs. 37,000/- pm (Advt. No. 32/2026 dated 26.11.2026).

application_fee.details: The fee is to be submitted at the time of the interview as a Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NIPER-SAS Nagar', payable at SAS Nagar (Mohali)/Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: NIPER Technical Assistant Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a separate last date to apply; candidates report on the walk-in date with the application form.

rows.details: Registration 03:00 pm - 03:30 pm at Recruitment Cell; interview from 03:30 pm onwards
Rs. 37,000/- pm (fixed); HRA as admissible or hostel facility, if available
Eligible Indian nationals with the required qualification, within the upper age limit of 35 years

content_sections.heading: About NIPER
content_sections.text: NIPER, SAS Nagar is described in the notice as an autonomous institute of national importance, set up by the Government of India under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, by an Act of Parliament. It offers higher education and advanced research in pharmaceutical sciences, technology and management. The Department of Pharmaceuticals has launched the Scheme for "Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma MedTech sector (PRIP)". Under it, NIPER Mohali is establishing a Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Anti-viral and Anti-bacterial drug discovery and development on its campus. The post is under this CoE (CoE-AVAB project).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: experience of handling cell cultures (BSL2), stem cells and microscopy. Upper age limit: 35 years (as on date of Walk-in-Interview). Age relaxation for SC / ST / OBC / PwBD etc. is as per Government of India rules. Candidates must attach valid proof to claim it. Only eligible Indian nationals having proven track record, command, expertise and deep knowledge in the respective area may appear. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: Essential: M. S. (Pharm.)/ M. Pharm./ M. Tech. in Biotechnology/ M.Sc. in Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/Microbiology/ Life Sciences or equivalent

content_sections.heading: NIPER Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be engaged in research related to stem cell culture and animal handling. The fellow would actively participate in lab seminars and other departmental activities. He/she will also maintain proper lab records, write grants and research papers actively and present the work in scientific conferences.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is to be submitted at the time of the interview as a Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NIPER-SAS Nagar', payable at SAS Nagar (Mohali)/Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The duly filled application form, downloaded from the Institute's website https://www.niper.gov.in/jobs , to be submitted at the Recruitment Cell during registration (03:00 pm - 03:30 pm). Self-attested copies of degree, certificates, marks sheets, experience certificate and reprint of important publications (if any), in support of the qualification and experience claimed. Photographs and signatures. Original documents and testimonials, which must be produced at the time of the interview. Demand Draft of the requisite application fee, if applicable. Valid proof for claiming age relaxation, if claimed.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates submit the application form at the Recruitment Cell during registration, between 03:00 pm and 03:30 pm. The walk-in interview is held from 03:30 pm onwards. The selection is based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. Ineligible candidates will not be interviewed. Original certificates and degrees are subject to verification before joining, in case of selection.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary, initially for one (01) year. It may be extended for other term(s) case-to-case, depending on the job requirement and the individual's performance. The engagement does not establish any right or claim for regularization or absorption against any vacant post in the Institute. Pay is Rs. 37,000/- pm (fixed). HRA is as admissible, or hostel facility, if available.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ascertain their eligibility before coming. Candidature is invalid ab-initio if the eligibility criteria are not fulfilled. Candidates with incomplete applications or without supporting enclosures, photographs, signatures and the prescribed fee will not be allowed to appear. Candidates who do not produce original documents at the interview will not be allowed for interview. Confirmation of attending can be sent to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] . No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. The Institute reserves the right to withdraw the advertised position at any time without assigning any reason, and to fill or not to fill the position. Its decision is final. Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NIPER Technical Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026 (Thursday), from 03:30 pm onwards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the NIPER walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Registration and submission of the filled application form is between 03:00 pm and 03:30 pm at the Recruitment Cell.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the NIPER walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at G-108, G-Block, NIPER-SAS Nagar – 160062 (Punjab).

faq.question: Q4. How many Technical Assistant vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 Technical Assistant position under the CoE-AVAB project.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for NIPER Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M. S. (Pharm.)/ M. Pharm./ M. Tech. in Biotechnology/ M.Sc. in Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/Microbiology/ Life Sciences or equivalent. Experience of handling cell cultures (BSL2), stem cells and microscopy is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. Relaxation for SC / ST / OBC / PwBD etc. is as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of the NIPER Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is Rs. 37,000/- pm, with HRA as admissible or hostel facility, if available.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates pay Rs. 500/- by Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NIPER-SAS Nagar' payable at SAS Nagar (Mohali)/Chandigarh. The fee is NIL for SC/ST/PWD/female candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: The selection is based on the performance of the candidate in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NIPER Technical Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is temporary, initially for one (01) year, and may be extended case-to-case. It gives no right or claim to regularization or absorption.
